_doc: Example catalog for llama-models-fetch (nomad-llama optional DX). Copy to ~/.config/llama-swap/catalog.json and add your own entries; sha256 = Hugging Face LFS oid of the file. The ids here mirror the models referenced by config.example.yaml — if you add a model to one file, add it to the other, or `ujust llama-models-fetch` will fetch weights nothing loads.
_local_weights: Weights produced locally (imatrix merges, MTP grafts) cannot be fetched by repo/file and therefore do not belong here: drop the file under /var/srv/nomad/gguf/local/<name>.gguf and reference /models/gguf/local/<name>.gguf in config.yaml. The production 4B on this host is such a file (HauhauCS MTP Q4_K_M); the fetchable UD-Q4_K_XL below is the drop-in equivalent.
